text:
jia: Heads-up  I opened a short PR to add a CLI-first example for rate caps + quota diagnostics in the metering guide. It shows both a curl/cli path and the SDK v4 call, plus a tiny PromQL snippet for the dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5345

matt: nice. can we be explicit about the ratecap headers people will see? e.g. `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` and show a quick parse example in bash.

ja: added a short bash parse example. also switched timestamps to ISO in all examples. draft below.

elaine: please add a one-line example of the `429` body shape and a recommended backoff header reader. saves support noise.

jia: added both. kept them tiny.

--- code samples ---

jia: ```bash
# cli / curl: query usage and inspect ratecap headers
resp_headers=$(curl -i -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-06-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-06-07T00:00:00Z","breakdown":"tier","filters":{"product":"inference-api"}}')

# extract remaining and reset (seconds)
remaining=$(echo "$resp_headers" | grep -i X-RateLimit-Remaining | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\\r')
reset_sec=$(echo "$resp_headers" | grep -i X-RateLimit-Reset | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\\r')
reset_iso=$(date -u -d "@$reset_sec" --iso-8601=seconds)

echo "remaining=$remaining, reset=$reset_iso"
```

jia: ```python
# SDK v4: similar query in code
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.usage.query(
    start="2026-06-01T00:00:00Z",
    end="2026-06-07T00:00:00Z",
    breakdown="tier",
    filters={"product":"inference-api"}
)
# resp.metrics -> [{"tier":"starter","tokens":12000}, {"tier":"pro","tokens":450000}]
print(resp.metrics)
```

jia: ```json
# example 429 body
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":30}
```

leo: For the dashboard, tiny PromQL target to show consumed tokens by tier: `sum by (tier) (redwood_usage_tokens_total{product="inference-api"})` — I'll add this to the docs snippet.

sanjay: add an FAQ line: rate caps are enforced per-account id across all regions; tier credits are prorated to the second; billing rounds at invoice generation. Also note reserved capacity consumes before on-demand credits.

billing-eng: confirm the billing phrasing: prorated to the second, charges rounded during billing run (no per-request rounding). added a clarifying sentence to the FAQ text in the PR.

docs-bot: PR updated: jia pushed 2 commits to docs/cli-ratecap-usage at 1847654488  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5345/files

matt: quick smoke: run the curl with $REDWOOD_KEY in staging. expect 200 and see X-RateLimit-* headers; if 429, sample body shape should match. thanks for the clear CLI angle.

jia: test passed in staging: curl shows headers, SDK returns metrics in same shape as the sample, prom target renders in dev grafana. merging after CI. :rocket:
